hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:0ccc4e1d-a6a5-4e9b-96e.title: Founding Sales @Verso (backed by Hexa)
hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:0ccc4e1d-a6a5-4e9b-96e.description: Founded in 2025 by Lydia Bellahouel (CEO) and Camille Epitalon (CTO), Verso is backed by Hexa http://hexa.cc/ (eFounders), the pioneer European startup studio behind 40+ companies including Front, Aircall and Spendesk. Consumer research has been slow and expensive for decades. We are building the company that changes that, and we need our first commercial hire: the person who brings our product to enterprise customers, closes our first flagship accounts, and helps define how Verso sells ABOUT VERSO Verso is an AI-native consumer research platform. Our AI designs the study, interviews real participants one to one over video in any language, and turns those conversations into a structured, evidence-backed report you can interrogate in chat. Days instead of weeks, at a fraction of the cost of a traditional agency, without trading rigor for speed. We sell to insights, marketing and innovation teams at global brands, with a strong pull from large CPG, beauty, telecom, retail, and the strategy consultancies that serve them. Early clients include Orange, Michelin, Europcar and dsm-firmenich. We are a small team with high standards and one clear thesis: qualitative research is high-signal and badly broken, and AI is finally good enough to fix it. We start with AI-moderated qualitative research and are building for each client a system of consumer intelligence: every study compounds into a living understanding of their consumers that their teams, and their own AI, can draw on over time. Lydia spent 7 years at BCG leading AI-powered transformation for consumer brands and knows the buyer's pain from the inside. Camille is an AI expert and a pioneer in agentic systems. Together they built Verso to turn consumer understanding into a real-time advantage for the brands we serve. The role We are hiring our Founding Sales, the first dedicated commercial hire at Verso. This is a hands-on, full-cycle role, and you work hand in hand with the founders, Lydia in particular, who leads commercial today. You prospect, run demos, scope pilots, and close enterprise contracts yourself. As we grow, you help define how Verso sells and have the opportunity to build and lead the commercial team. To be clear on the shape of it: you close deals now, and you grow into running the function next. This is not a co-founder seat, it is the first commercial hire, with real room to make the role your own. If you want the leadership part without the selling part, this is not it. What you will own - From first meeting to signes customer. You work closely with our Founding GTM, who builds demand across outbound, inbound and events. You generate pipeline together, while also leveraging your own network and converting inbound opportunities into customers. - The sales process itself. You turn founder-led selling into something repeatable: the motion, the collateral, the CRM discipline, the qualification bar, the pricing conversation. You decide what good looks like and write it down so the next hire can run it. - Enterprise relationships. Our buyers are Heads of Insights and research leaders who buy on trust, not on a feature list. You build that trust, turn a first pilot into an annual program, and grow accounts study by study. - AI-driven selling. You use AI across your own workflow, from research and prospecting to follow-ups and proposals, and you sell a product that is itself AI-native. You are fluent enough to demo it credibly and to make the "rigor, not hype" case to a skeptical researcher. - Voice of the customer. You are closest to the market and bring structured feedback to the founders, helping shape what we build next. Who you are - You have 5+ years of experience in enterprise B2B sales and have personally closed complex, consultative deals. You know how to navigate long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles and turn initial projects into long-term customer relationships. - You run the full cycle without a playbook handed to you, and you are comfortable being the pe

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ab60632d-1818-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Portuguese Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland. This opportunity is designed for an experienced Portuguese voice professional interested in helping shape the next generation of AI-powered speech technologies. You will contribute your voice expertise to training data that helps AI systems communicate with greater clarity, accuracy, and naturalness. The role combines professional voice performance with speech evaluation, linguistic annotation, and AI model feedback. You will record scripted Portuguese content and assess AI-generated speech for pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional authenticity. Your insights will help improve voice models used across areas such as education, entertainment, accessibility, and digital communication. You’ll work with advanced AI tools while applying your professional judgment and attention to linguistic detail. This is a flexible freelance opportunity for a skilled Portuguese voice actor looking to make a meaningful contribution to AI development. Record high-quality scripted speech samples in Portuguese for use in AI training and voice model development. Evaluate AI-generated speech for linguistic accuracy, pronunciation, naturalness, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional variation. Identify, annotate, and clearly document errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated voice outputs. Provide expert feedback that helps improve Portuguese speech models and their ability to produce natural, expressive communication. Collaborate with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, voice design guidelines, and quality standards. Apply professional voice acting expertise to ensure recordings demonstrate appropriate clarity, authenticity, delivery, and emotional nuance. Consistently maintain high-quality audio recordings using professional equipment and a suitable recording environment. Follow project instructions, quality standards, annotation guidelines, and data-handling requirements accurately and consistently. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in Portuguese voice acting, dubbing, narration, broadcasting, or a closely related performance discipline. Strong command of spoken Portuguese, including accurate pronunciation, natural intonation, pacing, and expressive delivery. Ability to recognize and evaluate subtle differences in speech quality, linguistic accuracy, tone, and regional variation. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to provide precise, constructive feedback on AI-generated speech. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain linguistic or performance-related observations effectively. Comfortable working with AI-powered tools and adapting to evolving workflows, evaluation criteria, and project requirements. Experience in voice training, coaching, linguistic annotation, speech evaluation, or AI data projects is a plus. Ability to work independently and consistently meet project requirements and quality standards. Access to a reliable computer, stable internet connection, high-quality microphone, and a quiet environment suitable for professional voice recording. Benefits Freelance contract opportunity with flexible remote work. Pay range of $6–$65 USD per hour , depending on experience, expertise, and geographic location. Opportunity to contribute directly to the development of next-generation AI voice and speech technologies. Work involving advanced AI tools and emerging speech technology workflows. Opportunity to apply professional Portuguese voice expertise to technology with global applications. No company-sponsored health insurance or paid time off, as this is a contractor position.
